purpose: Turkish physiotherapy education: supplemental primary guidelines and original assessment-developer references.
editorialRules: Sentetik eğitim vakası: Kurgusal verilerle oluşturulmuştur; gerçek hasta kaydı değildir. Her generated case should carry this explicit label.
Yayımlanmış olgu: Açık erişimli bilimsel bir yayına bağlantıdır; siteye ait gerçek hasta kaydı değildir. Published cases must be separated from synthetic teaching cases.
Do not reproduce patient images, dates, occupations, institutions, individual measurements or narratives. Extract only general assessment-learning questions in original words.
Case reports illustrate clinical reasoning and reporting; they cannot establish efficacy, universal exercise dose or prognosis.

No universal cutoffs or error-free clinical claims. Retain population, language/version, equipment, assistance, assessor training and repeat-test conditions. Link copyrighted assessment manuals rather than reproducing items.

sources.note: 2023 guideline; recommendation text verified through official search result.

Giriş/çıkışta uygun geçerli araçlarla işlevi izleme; hedefleri kişiyle belirleme.

Öğretim uygulaması: tekrar testlerinde ilaç zamanı ve yardımcı cihaz koşullarını ayrıca kaydetme; bu kayıt önerisi eğitimsel çıkarımdır.

verificationLimitations: Verified means title and URL were present in primary official search results or opened primary pages; not every linked full document was line-by-line appraised.
NICE direct fetches sometimes returned 403; official search results were used, with a specific stale-cache caveat for NG59.
Local Turkish measurement validation, translation permission, professional scope and institutional protocols require their own checks before implementing scored clinical calculators.
